bl.bannerSub: NLM's own item-by-item check of BeatLeader's written ranking criteria (as of {date}). This is not an official result from BeatLeader or BS Map Check.
bl.foot: ✖ Violation = breaks a numeric rule   ⚠ Check = possible violation or needs justification   ☐ Manual = cannot be judged automatically. Click a beat to jump there.
bl.footSub: Source: Ranking Criteria on beatleader.wiki (fetched {date}). The criteria may change without notice.
bl.r.R1.A.1: Map BPM is the song's BPM (or a multiple of it)
bl.r.R1.A.2: Audio beats and the grid are lined up as well as possible (audio setup or BPM events)
bl.r.R1.A.3: Audio is of acceptable quality and in .ogg format (.egg allowed)
bl.r.R1.A.4: Cover image is at least 256×256 px, 1:1, png/jpg/jpeg
bl.r.R1.B.1: Song Time Offset is unused or zero
bl.r.R1.B.2: Shuffle and Shuffle Period are unused or zero
bl.r.R1.B.3: Defined (official) color schemes provide all colors
bl.r.R1.B.4: Wall width and duration > 0 and height ≠ 0 (negative height only if it stays out of the grid)
bl.r.R1.B.6: Object beats are not negative and not past the final beat of the song
bl.r.R1.B.7: Walls do not extend past the song (beat + duration ≤ final beat)
bl.r.R1.B.8: NJS events use no unsupported easings (Sine/Cubic/Quart/Quint/Expo)
bl.r.R1.C: No external mods or programs are required
bl.r.R1.D.1: At least 1.5 s before the first interactable object (2 s recommended)
bl.r.R1.D.2: At least 2 s after the last interactable object
bl.r.R1.E: No mismaps, mistakes or unintentional mapping
bl.r.R1.F: At least 45 s from the first note to the last note or chain link
bl.r.R1.G: Sufficiently different from other difficulties / mapsets (40% identical → only the oldest)
bl.r.R2.A: Each note is within 12 ms of a timing point (incl. intended rhythm rules)
bl.r.R2.B: Repeating sounds use consistent timing points
bl.r.R2.C: Rhythm choice is consistent within a section
bl.r.R3.A.1: Objects do not intersect in Z (same cell within 0.5 m)
bl.r.R3.A.2: Objects (except walls) do not intersect walls
bl.r.R3.B: Pre-swing is not blocked by an opposite-color note or chain
bl.r.R4.A.1: No excessive notes to prolong a swing (pauls, dot spam, etc.)
bl.r.R4.A.2: Multi-note patterns have a single swing speed
bl.r.R4.A.3: Effective slider precision at least 1/16 of the section precision (1/8 for a 2-note window)
bl.r.R4.A.4: Slider swing speed is consistent per section
bl.r.R4.A.5: Sliders and window sliders share the same effective precision in a section
bl.r.R4.A.6: Chain duration ≤ 200% of the average effective slider duration
bl.r.R4.B.1: Multi-note swings are hittable within 45° of the starting angle
bl.r.R4.B.2: Swings deviate in only one direction
bl.r.R4.B.3: Swing path deviations have a reasonable radius
bl.r.R4.C: Patterns do not encourage hand claps
bl.r.R5.A: Hittable objects are visible long enough to react (vision block equation)
bl.r.R5.B.1: Notes, chains and bombs are not hidden behind walls or bomb walls
bl.r.R5.B.3: Bottom walls do not hide spawns in their lane (until 0.25 beats after the end)
bl.r.R5.C: Resets are not ambiguous or unreadable
bl.r.R6.A: No chains (incl. links) within the first 16 notes
bl.r.R6.B.1: Chains are not reversed (head before links)
bl.r.R6.B.2: Chains turn no more than 45° from the head's direction (dot head = down)
bl.r.R6.C.1: Chain heads are inside the 4×3 grid
bl.r.R6.C.2: Links may go one lane outside horizontally but not above/below the grid
bl.r.R6.D: Chains are at least 12.5% links versus empty space
bl.r.R6.E: Time from the last link to the next note ≥ chain duration (per hand)
bl.r.R6.F: Arcs are not connected to bombs
bl.r.R6.G.2: Chains have at least one visible link (slice count ≥ 2)
bl.r.R7.A: Bombs are not in the swing path of a note or chain
bl.r.R7.B: A light of at least 50 brightness is on from 250 ms before a bomb until it passes
bl.r.R7.C: Bombs do not force a saber outside the 4×3 grid
bl.r.R8.A.1: Walls leave enough space to avoid them comfortably
bl.r.R8.A.2: At least 250 ms to avoid wall boundaries (235 ms in exceptional cases)
bl.r.R8.A.3: Dodge walls forcing more than 2 head moves per second need justification
bl.r.R8.B: Walls do not force the player into the outer lanes
bl.r.R8.C: Walls ≤ 13.8 ms trail a legal wall in the same lane by ≤ 250 ms (any wall ≤ 100 ms)
bl.r.R8.D.1: During and 0.5 beats after a crouch wall, bottom-row middle notes count as vision blocks
bl.r.R8.D.2: During a crouch wall, nothing is placed above the middle layer
bl.r.R9: Variable NJS (minimum 1, base NJS within range, no objects pulled into range)
bl.r.R10.A: On average at least one light event per beat
bl.r.R10.B: The lightshow does not significantly hinder vision
bl.r.R11.A: The song is officially available and one official release is the metadata source
bl.r.R11.D.1: Song name matches official metadata (incl. capitalization)
bl.r.R11.D.2: Song name contains no tags such as feat./Remix (use the sub name)
bl.r.R11.E: Sub name tags are written and ordered correctly
bl.r.R11.F.1: Song author matches official metadata (incl. capitalization)
bl.r.R11.F.2: Song author contains no tags such as feat./cover
bl.r.R11.G: Mapper field lists all mappers and lighters (or a group name)
bl.r.R11.H.1: Difficulty names do not overlap; line limits (1 diff: 1 line, 2: 2 lines, 3+: 3 lines)
bl.r.R11.H.5: Difficulties are ordered by increasing stars (0.5★ leniency)

bl.m.boxLights: V3 light event boxes cannot be simulated; check visually

bl.m.bombDark: Bombs with dark time within 250 ms before them (fades approximated as 1 s on)
bl.m.dodgeFast: Dodge walls moving the head side to side within 0.5 s
bl.m.outerLane: Walls blocking both middle lanes at once
bl.m.illegalWall: Walls ≤ 13.8 ms not trailing another wall

bl.m.crouchHigh: Objects on the top row during a crouch wall
bl.m.njsEventsUsed: {n} NJS event(s) present (check this rule manually)

bl.m.specialChar: Untypeable symbols in {field}: "{chars}" (substitute a look-alike or the symbol name)
bl.m.nameTag: Song name seems to contain a tag: "{v}"
bl.m.authorTag: Song author seems to contain a tag: "{v}"
bl.m.customLabels: Custom difficulty names: {list} (check overlap and line count in game)
bl.m.defaultNames: NLM writes the standard difficulty names (no overlap or line issues)
bl.n.R3.B: Defined only by images. "Before the swing" is taken as the second half of the gap since the same hand's previous note (max 0.5 s)
bl.n.R3.C: Shows BS Map Check's hitbox checks as candidates
bl.n.R4.A.2: Shows BS Map Check "Varying swing speed" as candidates
bl.n.R4.A.3: Section precision cannot be detected, so 1/4 precision is assumed (for 1/8 sections the minimum is 1/32)
bl.n.R4.A.6: "Effective duration" is approximated by the time from the first to the last note
bl.n.R4.C: Shows BS Map Check "Handclap pattern" as candidates
bl.n.R5.A: BeatLeader's equation: (750-325)·e^(-★/7.6-Tech·0.06)+325 ms. Enter BeatLeader's star and tech ratings (estimates before ranking). Check the bottom-row exception (follows parity) visually
bl.n.R6.D: The text gives no formula; the chain squish factor is taken as the link ratio
bl.n.R7.A: "In the swing path" is taken as the cell before/after the cut direction
bl.n.R7.B: Brightness 50 is taken as 0.5; basic light events are simulated
bl.n.R8.A.2: Shows BS Map Check "2-wide center obstacle (under 250ms)" as candidates
bl.n.R8.A.3: Candidates where dodge walls blocking one middle lane switch sides within 0.5 s

rt.title: Estimate difficulty (approx. BeatLeader stars)
rt.needNlm: v{v} is available, but it requires a newer version of NLM.
rt.intro: This feature needs the add-on plugin nlm-rating (about 20 MB). "Install from GitHub" downloads it from the source below and saves it in the plugins folder next to this app.
rt.noChart: There is no chart to measure
rt.foot: Approximate values computed with BeatLeader's public source code. They may differ from beatleader.xyz (Acc in particular can come out lower). This is not an official BeatLeader tool.
rt.footSub: Difficulties with fewer than 20 notes cannot be measured. Speeds: SS=0.85x / FS=1.2x / SFS=1.5x.
